    @Test
    void declinesInvalidPanWithoutCallingAcquirer() {
        when(cardValidator.isValidNumber("1234")).thenReturn(false);

        AuthorizationResponse response = service.authorize("1234", 12, 2027, new BigDecimal("10.00"));

        assertThat(response.isApproved()).isFalse();
        assertThat(response.reason()).isEqualTo("INVALID_PAN");
        verifyNoInteractions(acquirer);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("amount above 30.00 requests SCA")
    void requestsScaAboveThreshold() {
        when(cardValidator.isValidNumber(PAN)).thenReturn(true);
        when(acquirer.authorize(PAN, new BigDecimal("30.01"), true)).thenReturn(AuthorizationResponse.approved("A1"));

        assertThat(service.authorize(PAN, 12, 2027, new BigDecimal("30.01")).isApproved()).isTrue();
    }
